Hi Lena — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the growth, that’s great to see.

High level answer: we can do a mid-contract capacity top-up and offer a graduated discount schedule if you commit the incremental capacity into next year’s annual commitment. That keeps your unit economics predictable while letting you scale now. I attached a straw-man quote for the uplift and a short amendment template.

Key points:
- Proration: you pay the pro-rated list price for the added capacity through your current term, then the remainder annualizes into next year at the agreed committed rate.
- Graduated discount: the more incremental committed spend you add, the higher the marginal discount. For example (straw-man): +25% incremental -> 5% discount on incremental dollars; +50% -> 10%; +100% -> 18%.
- Minimum term to qualify: incremental capacity must be included in the renewal commitment (12-month term) to get the graduated discounts.
- Contract path: amendment is usually sufficient; we can include an exhibit with the technical capacity and a billing schedule.

I want to make sure we can get approvals internally for the tiered bands. Looping in Ben (sales leader) and Marissa (pricing) to confirm. Expect an updated quote by Wed EOD.

Want a quick call Tues afternoon?

Best,
Dylan Brooks

Adding pricing detail. I ran margin sims based on the usage profile in the attachment. Outcome: we can support the following tiered structure if FluxData commits the incremental spend into the 12-month renewal: 

- Tier A: incremental +10-29% of current ARR -> 4% discount on incremental dollars (effective blended ~2.5% after proration)
- Tier B: incremental +30-59% -> 9% discount on incremental dollars (effective blended ~6%)
- Tier C: incremental +60%+ -> 15% discount on incremental dollars (effective blended ~11%)

Notes:
- To preserve economics we will not apply the discount retroactively; proration runs at list, then annualized dollars get the tiered rate at renewal.
- If FluxData requests Dedicated or Reserved pools as part of the uplift, switch to a reserved pricing schedule — this may change the discount ceilings.

Monica, can you prepare the blended pricing table and the amendment draft? I’ll include the margin approval in the pricing doc.

-Marissa

Summary (proposal highlights):
- Immediate top-up: pro-rated at list for remainder of current term.
- Annualization: on renewal, the incremental amount will be added to your committed volume; the committed rate per tier will apply to incremental dollars for the next 12 months.
- Graduated tiers (final proposal): Tier A +10-29% -> 4% incremental discount; Tier B +30-59% -> 9%; Tier C +60%+ -> 15%.
- Max discount cap for this path: 15% (per Marissa/Ben). For Reserved/Dedicated conversions we can provide a different schedule.
- Contract path: amendment + exhibit. We have attached an editable amendment draft.

Next steps for FluxData:
1) Review the attached spreadsheet which includes blended effective pricing and proration examples.
2) Confirm which uplift band you're targeting (estimates are fine).
3) If accepted, return signed amendment (we can sign electronically) by Nov 24 to meet your internal deadline.

Would you like to schedule a 30-minute call Monday to walk through the math?
